name: Rubicante
description: (Tag:fire)(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Purgatory's Invitation", Rubicante is a flamethrower Teigu with a large wearable canister. It fires extremely hot glue-like flames that melt metal and cannot be extinguished even by water, plus fireball projectiles or a near-nuclear self-destruct blast. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to use and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
